card.name: Ends of CDI and anemia terms
card.fires_on: The last piece of a term in warning text: the "I" ending "CDI" (C. difficile infection) and "emia" ending "anemia" in NSAID anemia warnings.

modes.label: CDI abbreviation
modes.description: The final letter of CDI in C. difficile warnings.
modes.example: CD<<I>> must be considered in all patients who present

modes.label: Anemia ending
modes.description: The "emia" piece completing "anemia" in the NSAID signs-or-symptoms sentence.
modes.example: has any signs or symptoms of an<<emia>>, monitor hemoglobin or hematocrit

modes.label: Renal effects sentence
modes.description: The word "effects" in "These effects are usually reversible" after NSAID-ACE inhibitor kidney text.
modes.example: including possible acute renal failure. These<< effects>> are usually reversible.

card.plain: It fires on the closing part of terms like CDI and anemia in standard label warnings.
